scope: Restore the user-supplied Display/Snaps/Info & Settings icon counts, row order, group gaps and auxiliary control positions using existing authored vectors.

reference.source: User-attached screenshot of the three sections

before: Generic flowing lists: 12 Display icons, 8 Snaps icons and 12 Info/Settings icons. Rows changed with dock width and unrelated text controls were present.

Snaps.bottom_row: 6 icons + four step buttons + Grid Snap

rendering: 296-unit reference canvas, fixed slots with no wrapping. Horizontal positions scale with dock width; icon and row height growth is capped at the 360px default dock, so wide docks do not push Layers below short-window bounds. Existing green/gold style and smooth typography retained. Dropdown chevrons are vector triangles.
assets: 37 previously unembedded existing authored SVG bindings added to the runtime palette; no bitmap extracted, no new icon artwork and no source assets modified. Existing aliases resolve the other slots.
availability: All three palettes remain non-invoking presentation adapters with unavailable-operation tooltips. No geometry/backend capability enabled.

build.command: cargo rustc -p om9-app --bin om9 --target-dir L:/om9-target -j 2 -- -o L:/om9-target/debug/om9-fixed-sidebar.exe

tests.coverage: Slot tests render 3 sections at 4 widths (12 combinations); asset test rasterizes all embedded base/menu/sidebar vectors. Integration tests cover non-invoking Snaps, layout, reset, persistence and resizing.
tests.execution: cargo test --lib sidebar_palettes; cargo test --lib icons::tests (both with --target-dir L:/om9-target -j 2). Fresh integration binaries in L:/om9-target/debug/deps run directly with --test-threads=1 after cargo hit a locked running om9.exe.

visual_review: All three final screenshots inspected. Display has 11 icons in 6+5 groups; Snaps has 9 top icons plus master, 6 bottom icons plus four step controls and grid; Info has two 7+4 rows, history top right and manipulators bottom right. No glyph placeholders among the command icons.

public_source_audit.note: Existing private/reference/binary/raster artifacts remain. No screenshot artwork or font assets added.

limitations: 125/150% are simulated egui zoom on one monitor; formal manual M01-UI acceptance remains pending.
Authored vector artwork is retained; this is count/order/slot fidelity, not a pixel copy of commercial artwork.
Commands and auxiliary controls that lack a verified owner remain disabled.
No reusable skill rule changed; this restores the selected reference layout.
